## Details type

Return type for get\_details calls. ActionHash returns a Record. EntryHash returns an Entry.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Details = {
    type: "Record";
    content: RecordDetails;
} | {
    type: "Entry";
    content: EntryDetails;
};
```
